# q15 A/C divider impedance experiment

This is an exploratory intrinsic experiment derived from rejected q15 run41277054717. Original eight master lengths stay2.6um/W32. The q15 sixteen resistor changes remain: eight output loads1.5um/W32, four buffer pullups1um/W8, four shunts3.4um/W4.

Read-only original-wave diagnostics41280306194 and41280275014 passed7 frozen-reader,13 event and8 transfer controls plus an authenticated actual-topology preflight. q15 A->AD had127 source transitions but only22 matched buffer crossings within the bounded125ps window; C->CD had128/14. The respective sampler-to-base median observed matched delays were61.9468ps and68.6585ps. These are diagnostic correlations, not proof that changing resistance fixes the circuit. Full35-file proofs031a9d3d6554b1574f4ba609279d3543cff03b8e and3266bcfca451cc2e8c06ac372409f1dbb240fb04 retain all events and original metrics.

## Controlled delta

Only eight additional A/C divider lengths change:
* Series R227,R229,R238,R240:3.6um ->1.8um, width1um.
* Ground shunts R228,R230,R239,R241:21.6um ->10.8um, width1um.

This preserves the geometric series/shunt length ratio and tests reduced input impedance. It does not assume unchanged loaded DC voltage: base current, contacts, output loading and device capacitance remain in the actual nonlinear simulation. D->S0/S1 dividers, all MIM capacitors, all HBT emitter counts, and all remaining device parameters are unchanged. In total exactly24 intrinsic length tokens differ from the authenticated original500-device model; this is a distinct target set from the older24-resistor master/buffer candidate.

The mutation requires exact500-device census, every targeted original model parameter, ordered terminals/net/cluster and complete native card tokens. Reversing the24 changes must recover every original model byte and composition value. Source controls include21 corruption refusals and5 archive refusals; actual preparation retains13 original binding controls.

All original prepare/measure function bodies,150fF sampler and50fF XOR loads,10ohm sources,1151 vectors, stimulus,125ps UI,100mV/37.5ps sampler,100mV/75ps XOR, device current/voltage and phase/VI gates remain fixed. Current at3mA per emitter remains a failure. Original distributed wire RC is retained for exploratory comparison; this is not fresh PEX or regenerated layout.

Run source controls first, preserve their complete proof, then independently reserve an empty exact-source release for one actual native run. Record all failures and full native/derived evidence on GitHub. No native archive, model, SPICE, wave or geometry is acquired locally. A passing circuit would still need a new full physical map for these eight divider instances, independently authored schematic changes, physical DRC/LVS, fresh RC, corners and closed-loop validation. FullPHY and finalchip timing remain open.

# Same-time C/D latch diagnosis

Run41282425236/sourceae6db2f7ee9a11bad03154f5401ca9837a3db6fb passed actual topology/current identity checks using existing q15-derived wave diagnostics031a9d3d6554b1574f4ba609279d3543cff03b8e. It did not simulate the later A/C-divider candidate. Full13-file proof007ac2338efc578c90ffb827e48b2ab0d31000dd, docs/evidence/cd-latch-diagnosis-41282425236. Thirteen is the proof file count, not a test count.

The diagnosis authenticates all500 devices and124HBT identities, complete follower/input-buffer/master/slave/hold/clock topology and same-time voltage/current identities. C followers areQ121/Q124, notQ122; D followersQ69/Q70. Master data clocks usecn, masterholdcp, slavedatacp andslaveholdcn.

At the original worst sample3.1ns, cp=1.3987045V, cn=1.1771133V. C master output/slave input differential magnitude140.084623mV becomes33.754185mV at the sampled slave output; D157.171451mV becomes22.772750mV. These140–157mV values are slave inputs, not master inputs. C/D master input differential magnitudes are115.949mV/206.510mV.

C/D slave differential collector currents are4.212637/4.548597mA, total5.152850/5.215113mA. Slave data clock totals4.992668/5.003827mA; hold-clock currents34.695919/32.220982uA. Slave hold total collector currents0.960992/0.859176mA are transient observations; incomplete terminal-current capture does not establish DC KCL or a short. Distinct distributed-RC leaf nodes of the same native nets can have different transient voltages.

Four retained events cover the worst C/D deadlines and worst samples. Strong sampled slave-input differential with weak sampled output motivates a controlled split A/B versus C/D load experiment; it does not prove the resize will work. All original acceptance limits remain unchanged.

# Full serial integration remains a separate requirement

Verified against root source c9d6ea5b2e49d52e73c33d96dcb18db1324abf05 on2026-11-01. The current hw/soc/rtl/soc_top.v is67444 bytes, SHA256 b782a7fbe7b9ad5abb0db67bd132907d71e1ef43c9451b9befa2f356b77d4847. Lines262-270 expose external link/training/retrain status and an8-bit packet stream. Lines988-997 feed those external values into the packet controller. This is not an internally owned trained serial link.

The qualified [shared receiver front](pcie-shared-serial-front-v1.md), source17033684f3dfd0c760ac7cf64d2e1dc1a4b2fdb0/run41223635170, covers50 positive RTL tests, two compiled mutation detections and two production hierarchies. Its recovered clock/raw bits are explicit testbench inputs. The shared aligned raw-record path and existing normal consumers do not establish normative training/equalization interpretation, logical lane mapping, descrambler handoff, full LTSSM or soc_top serial connectivity.

The current mainchip routing job41270471645 preserves the original logical/clock records while repairing scoped signal routes and antenna diode connectivity. Its predecessor is the packet-interface SoC. A successful route/DRC/antenna result cannot by itself establish serial PHY integration. The analog CDR nominal screen and the complete clocked physical pipeline must also close independently.

The official [PCI-SIG Base3.0 catalog](https://pcisig.com/PCIExpress/Specs/Base/_3.0) was rechecked on2026-11-01. Its download still redirects to [member login](https://members.pcisig.com/site/login?return=/wg/PCI-SIG/document/8265). The existing request for authorized specification access remains pending. Public overview material is not treated as a complete training/descrambler correctness oracle.

The full objective therefore still requires the actual CDR/PLL/SERDES signal and clock sources, shared receiver and transmit paths, complete training/state ownership and packet-controller integration, native layout/RC verification and unchanged final multi-corner setup/hold/electrical limits. No green standalone test, metadata map, nominal analog point or packet-interface route substitutes for that integrated evidence.
